'''Scarn''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] hired by the Qreph brothers to scam [[Omad Kaeg]] of his shares from the mining cooperative that he was involved with in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]]. He and his affiliate, [[Jakal]], along with their shadowing [[Nargon]], [[Qizak]], confronted Kaeg about the marker he owed in the [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game they scammed him in the [[Red Ronto]] aboard [[Brink Station]] just as Kaeg was meeting with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] [[Solo family/Legends|Solo]]. The Solos called Scarn out on his scam, which resulted in a deadly confrontation that saw to the mercenary's death, with his contract with the Qrephs unfulfilled.
